headline: Waiver granted for culvert pipe at 23 Wilson Road, part of an eight-lot subdivision.
summary: The applicant asked for a waiver to run a culvert under Wilson Road with 2 1/2 feet of cover instead of 3 feet. Staff recommended granting it if the pipe was changed to reinforced concrete pipe, and the applicant said that change was made. Earlier, the applicant withdrew its application for 60 residential units at 196 and 198 Rockingham Road, so it was not heard.
decisions: Granted a waiver allowing less than 3 feet of pipe cover at 23 Wilson Road.
discussion: Wilson Road drainage: Concerns were raised about standing water at a driveway curve across from the culvert. The applicant said road work would improve the curve and sight distance.
Detention pond upkeep: The town may take over maintenance of the detention ponds. The board said that was not part of its decision.
Nearby resident concerns: A neighbor asked about pond size, tree clearing, a new access road, and a strip of land to be sold. Staff agreed to follow up with the resident.
Pipe strength: Members asked whether the reinforced pipe could carry heavy loads. The applicant said it was rated to carry anything driven over it, including fire trucks.

decision_evidence.quote: Um I'll make a motion to um recommend the waiver, which is um we've received the letter and recommend based on staff's memo of November 4th, 2026. ... The um waiver has been granted.

decision_titles: Culvert pipe waiver at 23 Wilson Road
